notes.title: Heavens Loss Release!!
notes.content:
Embark on a surreal journey where nothing is as it seems. In Heaven's Loss, you awaken as a frog in an unfamiliar world, guided only by your curiosity. Ascend the stairs to meet an enigmatic Angel, then plunge into the depths of a strange universe where your every move unravels more of the mystery.

Swim through forgotten realms, roll across a bizarre flat earth, and soar in a flying car on a quest that defies logic and transcends reality. With each new world, you'll face puzzles that challenge not just your skills, but your perception of what's possible.

Are you ready to explore the unknown and uncover the secrets that lie beyond the portal? Heaven's Loss is not just a game—it's a poetic adventure through sound and space, where your journey is as unpredictable as the worlds you traverse.

Unravel the mystery. Find your way back to heaven... or is it Heaven's loss?
